case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Client, objectives, quantified $1.18M savings and multiple documented proof points are available—sufficient for a strong, marketing-ready case study.
case_study_packaging.headline: PE-backed dermatology network secures $1.18 M in recurring savings and 6× ROI through Treya’s strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Adult & Pediatric Dermatology (APDerm) had grown to dozens of clinics across New England, but purchasing remained highly decentralized. Fragmented vendor contracts, limited spend visibility, and pandemic-driven cost inflation were eroding margins and slowing Waud Capital Partners’ value-creation timeline. APDerm needed a fast, low-disruption way to leverage its enterprise buying power and contain indirect costs without distracting clinical staff.
approach_summary: Analyzed accounts-payable data and supplier files to build a $6.3 M addressable baseline across 12 indirect spend categories.
Executed two waves of competitive RFPs and incumbent renegotiations—retaining incumbents in most cases to accelerate implementation.
Leveraged Premier and HPG GPO tiers to cut medical-supply pricing by 27 %, delivering $485 K annual savings with McKesson.
Consolidated 50+ vendors—e.g., routing all 33 sites to one janitorial provider and moving parcel shipping to Treya’s UPS program—to unlock scale discounts of 20 - 30 %.
Established centralized reporting, contract repository, and supplier QBR cadence to sustain savings and procurement discipline.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $1,179,965 in verified annual run-rate savings—19 % of the $6.3 M baseline—triple the contractual savings guarantee and equivalent to a 6.2× return on the $190 K fixed project fee. Beyond the financial impact, APDerm now benefits from standardized pricing, a 50-vendor reduction, and new visibility into spend that positions the platform for future growth and tuck-in acquisitions.
where_we_were_unique: Achieved first contract signature and savings realization within 90 days of kick-off.
Healthcare-specific GPO expertise unlocked pricing not accessible through standard distributor channels.
Collaborative, low-disruption approach kept 80 % of spend with preferred incumbents, protecting clinic operations.
Delivered savings despite inflationary headwinds, outperforming the 2× fee savings guarantee by more than 3×.

generation_notes: Savings figure of $1.18 M is the combined Phase-1 and Phase-2 low-end totals from Aug 2022 close-out deck.
ROI calculated as $1.18 M ÷ $0.19 M fixed fee = 6.2×.
Approach bullets ordered to mirror project chronology and impact size.
